# Geoggernaut

> Geography quiz games and tricky map puzzles: name countries from their shapes, borders, rivers and cities.

Geoggernaut is free, needs no account and is played in the browser. The daily challenge is five puzzles, the same for everyone that day. Free Play is practice: pick a game, or a mix of them, and play as many rounds as you like.

There is no public API. To send someone to a game, link them to one of the pages below; do not call the site's `/api` endpoints.

## Games

- [Tripoints](https://geoggernaut.com/play/tripoints): Name the three countries that meet at a point.
- [City Map](https://geoggernaut.com/play/city-map): Name a country from where its cities are.
- [Merged Countries](https://geoggernaut.com/play/merged-countries): Name the two neighbouring countries merged into one shape.
- [Missing Country](https://geoggernaut.com/play/missing-country): Name the country hidden between its neighbours.
- [Follow the River](https://geoggernaut.com/play/follow-the-river): Name a river from the countries it flows through.
- [Land Borders](https://geoggernaut.com/play/land-borders): Name a country from its land borders alone.
- [Waterways](https://geoggernaut.com/play/waterways): Name a country from its rivers and lakes.
- [Coastlines](https://geoggernaut.com/play/coastlines): Name a country from its coastline alone.
- [River Shapes](https://geoggernaut.com/play/river-shapes): Name a river from its shape alone.
- [Lake Shapes](https://geoggernaut.com/play/lake-shapes): Name a lake from its shape alone.
- [Border Shapes](https://geoggernaut.com/play/border-shapes): Name the two countries a border separates, from its shape alone.

## Pages

- [Home](https://geoggernaut.com/): choose a game to play.
- [Daily challenge](https://geoggernaut.com/daily): today's five puzzles.
- [Credits and privacy](https://geoggernaut.com/privacy): data sources and what the site stores.
